No semantic security findings were identified.

content.user_title: Instrument Node.js Apps with Azure Monitor
content.value_statement: Teams need reliable telemetry in Node.js apps without hand-building every OpenTelemetry component. This skill shows Azure Monitor setup patterns for tracing, metrics, logs, sampling, and shutdown.
actual_capabilities: Shows package choices for Azure Monitor auto-instrumentation, exporters, and custom log ingestion.
Demonstrates early Azure Monitor initialization for Node.js and TypeScript applications.
Explains configuration options for tracing, metrics, live metrics, performance counters, and instrumented libraries.
Provides patterns for custom spans, metrics, log exporters, span processors, sampling, and shutdown.
Shows Azure Monitor custom logs ingestion with Data Collection Endpoints and Azure identity credentials.
limitations: Does not deploy Azure resources or create Data Collection Rules.
Does not validate connection strings, endpoint names, or Azure permissions.
Examples require project-specific testing before production use.
Telemetry volume, schema design, and Azure costs remain the user responsibility.

use_cases.title: Add service telemetry
use_cases.description: Configure automatic tracing, metrics, and logs for a TypeScript API before it enters production.

use_cases.title: Standardize observability setup
use_cases.description: Create a repeatable Azure Monitor setup pattern for multiple Node.js services.

use_cases.title: Tune telemetry signal quality
use_cases.description: Adjust sampling, custom dimensions, and span processing so Azure Monitor receives useful operational data.

prompt_templates.title: Start Azure Monitor setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a TypeScript service
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to outline the first Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry setup steps for my Node.js TypeScript service.

prompt_templates.title: Plan full instrumentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design tracing, metrics, logs, sampling, and shutdown handling for my Express TypeScript service.

prompt_templates.title: Review exporter options
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to compare auto-instrumentation with manual Azure Monitor trace, metric, and log exporter setup.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize production telemetry
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to propose production telemetry settings for Azure Monitor, including sampling, custom dimensions, and log ingestion boundaries.

output_examples.input: Set up Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry for a new TypeScript API.
output_examples.output: A setup plan covering package selection, initialization order, connection string configuration, basic traces, metrics, logs, and shutdown handling.

output_examples.input: Decide between auto-instrumentation and manual exporters.
output_examples.output: A comparison of the recommended distro approach, custom exporter control, operational tradeoffs, and when each option fits.

output_examples.input: Improve telemetry quality for a busy service.
output_examples.output: A production checklist for sampling ratio, custom dimensions, span filtering, offline storage, and log ingestion review.

best_practices: Initialize Azure Monitor before importing application modules.
Store connection strings in environment configuration, not source files.
Test sampling, shutdown, and log ingestion behavior in a staging environment.
anti_patterns: Hardcoding real Application Insights connection strings in code or prompts.
Enabling full trace sampling in high-traffic production services without cost review.
Adding custom dimensions that contain secrets, tokens, or personal data.

faq.question: Does this skill create Azure Monitor resources?
faq.answer: No. It explains application-side setup and assumes Azure resources already exist.

faq.question: Can it help with TypeScript services?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples target Node.js and TypeScript applications.

faq.question: Does it cover automatic instrumentation?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows the Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry distro and initialization order.

faq.question: Does it cover manual exporters?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes trace, metric, and log exporter setup patterns.

faq.question: Is it a replacement for Azure documentation?
faq.answer: No. Use it as implementation guidance and verify details against your Azure environment.

faq.question: Does it handle sensitive telemetry data?
faq.answer: No. You must review telemetry fields to avoid sending secrets or personal data.
